result.summary: Implemented ISS-0100 Iteration 4 (final): applied tenant_type='test' + production_tenant_id=<default tenant literal> to all remaining OIDC inline-occurrence fixture INSERTs -- 2 occurrences in oidc12_realm_tenant_binding_test.zig (lines 89, 172), 1 occurrence in oidc15_realm_deletion_test.zig (line 227, tenant table only; the nearby users table INSERT at line 322 was confirmed untouched), and 3 occurrences in oidc35_onboarding_test.zig (lines 739, 796, 806, where idp_realm_id correctly reuses the $2 slug bind per design SS3.10). All edits verified against the actual current file contents (not stale line numbers) before editing. `zig build` exits 0 with zero 'error set' output. Isolated per-file `zig test`-equivalent compile+run verification (via temporary, fully-reverted build.zig test steps with a minimal correct module set) confirmed oidc12 and oidc15 compile cleanly and their tenant-table INSERTs execute against the real schema with no column/constraint errors; the only runtime failures in that isolated harness were unrelated 'relation does not exist' errors caused by the minimal harness not running the full migration/schema-setup path main_test.zig normally provides -- not a defect in the fix. oidc35 could not be isolated-compiled because it depends on helpers.zig's TestHarness (which needs a root-module shim matching main_test.zig's exports) -- instead verified by direct diff inspection: the 3 edited call sites are structurally identical (same conn.exec/query shape, same column-count/placeholder-count/bound-arg-count correspondence) to the proven-compiling oidc12/oidc15 edits. Ran the full `zig build test-integration` suite twice: once with Iteration 4 applied (102 failures) and once with Iteration 4 reverted via git stash as a true baseline (107 failures) on the same shared long-lived test DB. Diffed the two unique-failure sets: 0 of the 5 tests that differ (new-looking or resolved-looking) touch tenant, oidc12, oidc15, oidc35, or any file this iteration modified -- all are pre-existing, unrelated flakiness from shared-DB-state/hardcoded-fixture-ID collisions across separate full-suite invocations (e.g. event_store 'instance_projections_pkey already exists', iss102 claim-race timing). Iteration 4 did not introduce any new failure; if anything the shared-DB failure count trended down (107 -> 102) consistent with fewer leaked production-typed fixture rows. Dedicated `zig build test-integration-iss503` (test_iss503_rls_removal.zig, the GBL-084/086 guard regression suite) passes cleanly (exit 0) both before and after this iteration's changes. env01_test.zig's TC-ENV-01-03 failed in both the baseline and iter4 runs identically ('expected 0, found 12') -- this counts tenant_type!='production' rows accumulated on this long-lived shared container across many prior sessions' test runs; it is pre-existing DB-state pollution, not a regression, and is unaffected by whether Iteration 4's edits are present. Note: env01_tenant_type_field_test.zig (distinct from env01_test.zig, which IS wired and IS the file covering TC-ENV-01-03) is a separate, never-wired, codegen-scaffold file with its own pre-existing compile errors (undeclared identifier 'generated', missing build_options module, pg.Conn/*pg.Conn mismatches) discovered during isolated-verification attempts -- entirely unrelated to this fix; not filed as a new issue because CLAUDE.md's design doc (SS4) explicitly scopes env0*_test.zig files as already-correct/out-of-scope and treats env01_test.zig as the canonical ENV-01 coverage, which did run.

issues.description: Pre-existing, already filed (GitHub #360): oidc09/10/11/12/15/35 are not wired into tests/integration/main_test.zig or any build.zig test target, so `zig build test-integration` never exercises their own test logic (including this iteration's fixture-hygiene edits) as part of normal CI. NEW issue discovered and filed during this iteration's verification (GitHub #361, local docs/issues/ISS-0103.json): tests/integration/oidc35_onboarding_test.zig does not compile in isolation -- two struct literals (bpm.api_auth.AuthContext at line ~98, onboarding_mod.OnboardingInput at lines 460/541) are stale against their current struct definitions, missing the required 'principal' field (added by ISS-403) and 'tenant_type'/'production_tenant_id' fields (added by ENV-01) respectively. Confirmed via `git show HEAD:...` that these struct literals predate and are unrelated to this ISS-0100 iteration's edits (which only touch tenant-table INSERT statements at lines 739/796/806, nowhere near the broken literals). This is additional concrete evidence for ISS-0102's finding that oidc35 is dead code from a CI perspective -- filed as its own issue per candidate_resolution sequencing with ISS-0102's wiring fix.
